Reporting-level data sheet on tropical forest ecoregions' timelines and progress of biomass recovery over a 20-year period.

Source: R/EcoregionReports.R
EcoregionReports.Rd

A dataset containing information about 26 tropical ecoregions, including primary forest biomass, regrowing forests' linear regression growth trends, biomass regrowth after 20 years, and the relationship between the 20-year status of regrowth and primary forest benchmark biomass levels.

data(EcoregionReports)

Format

A data frame with 26 rows and 11 variables:

ECO_ID

Unique numeric ID for each ecoregion, per the RESOLVE Ecoregions dataset

ECO_NAME

Descriptive geographic name for each ecoregion

pri_n

Count of points sampled within primary forests

pri_median

Median aboveground biomass measured within primary forests, Mg/ha

tmf_n

Count of points sampled within regrowing forests, via the Tropical Moist Forests (TMF) dataset

tmf_slope

Slope/growth rate of median aboveground biomass per regrowth age, via TMF regrowth years, Mg/ha/yr

tmf_int

Intercept of the linear regression equation of median aboveground biomass per TMF age, Mg/ha

tmf_r2

R^2 coefficient of determination from the linear regression equation of biomass/age

tmf_agbd20

Predicted aboveground biomass after 20 years of regrowth, via the regression model, Mg/ha

tmf_pct20

Percent that the 20-year biomass reaches compared to primary forest biomass, %

tmf_timetopri

Estimated time needed for biomass to reach primary forest levels under linear regrowth, years

Source

RESOLVE Ecoregions: Dinerstein et al., 2017 (https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=37ea320eebb647c6838c23f72abae5ef#overview)

GEDI L4A Aboveground Biomass Density, Version 2.1: Dubayah et al., 2020 (https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/LARSE_GEDI_GEDI04_A_002?_gl=11sanpqq_upMQ.._gaNzU3ODYzOTgzLjE3ODk2NzEyMTE._ga_SM8HXJ53K2*czE3ODk2NzEyMTEkbzEkZzAkdDE3ODk2NzEyMTEkajYwJGwwJGgw)

JRC Tropical Moist Forests Annual Change Collection: Vancutsem et al., 2021 (https://forobs.jrc.ec.europa.eu/TMF/data)
